description: Source code for the BuiltInFunctionEmulator class, which manages emulation of built-in functions in a shader translation context, including adding, finding, and marking functions for emulation.

classes.name: BuiltInFunctionEmulator
classes.description: Class responsible for managing emulation of built-in functions, including storing emulated functions, dependencies, and tracking which functions are called.

classes.name: BuiltInFunctionEmulationMarker
classes.description: Helper class derived from TIntermTraverser used to mark functions for emulation during AST traversal.

methods.name: addEmulatedFunction
methods.description: Adds an emulated function definition associated with a unique ID.

methods.name: addEmulatedFunctionWithDependency
methods.description: Adds an emulated function with a dependency on another function.

methods.name: isOutputEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no functions marked for emulation.

methods.name: outputEmulatedFunctions
methods.description: Outputs all emulated functions to a sink.

methods.name: findEmulatedFunction
methods.description: Finds the emulated function body for a given unique ID.

methods.name: setFunctionCalled
methods.description: Marks a function as called, considering dependencies.

methods.name: markBuiltInFunctionsForEmulation
methods.description: Traverses the AST to mark built-in functions for emulation.

methods.name: addFunctionMap
methods.description: Adds a query function for emulated functions.

methods.name: WriteEmulatedFunctionName
methods.description: Outputs the name of an emulated function.
